name: Logo Finder
description: Find channel logos in a preferred style from Schedules Direct and tv-logos and apply them after a dry-run report.
author: tylertufano

fields.label: Channel profile
fields.help_text: Only channels in this channel profile are considered.

fields.label: Sources
fields.help_text: Comma-separated sources in order: sd (Schedules Direct), tvlogos (tv-logo/tv-logos). Overrides always run first.

fields.label: Default country
fields.help_text: Two-letter country code used when the channel's tvg_id has no country suffix (for example us, uk, ca).

fields.label: Overrides
fields.help_text: JSON object keyed by channel number: a URL to use, or "keep" to leave the channel alone.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Report the proposed logo changes without writing anything.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Assign the proposed logos and write the report. Existing logos are never deleted.
